characters.name: Minh
characters.ability: Protection: while disposition is 60+, gang shakedowns cost you nothing.
characters.flavourText: Feed his ma a good bowl and nobody touches your cart. Ever.

characters.name: Bảy
characters.ability: Heads Up: at disposition 50+, you see tomorrow's event a day early.
characters.flavourText: Sees everything on the street. Charges extra to unsee it.

characters.name: Sáu
characters.ability: District Queen: at disposition 70+, all GANG events resolve in your favour.
characters.flavourText: Runs three blocks and one very good karaoke bar.

characters.name: Mr Phúc
characters.ability: Rent Radar: rent hikes trigger twice as often while your reputation is 70+.
characters.flavourText: Smells fresh paint and raises the rent the same afternoon.

characters.name: Madam Kim
characters.ability: Old Recipes: at disposition 60+, your lease events offer a friendly option.
characters.flavourText: Will forgive late rent for a bowl that tastes like 1985.

characters.name: Tuấn
characters.ability: Hustle: customers wait 20% longer before walking away.
characters.flavourText: Once delivered six bowls through rush hour without spilling a drop.

characters.name: Lan
characters.ability: Spotless: +1 kitchen cleanliness during health inspections.
characters.flavourText: Dreams of her own stall. Practises plating on the dish rack.

characters.name: Hương
characters.ability: Front of House: walk-aways hurt reputation 50% less.
characters.flavourText: Remembers every regular's order and exactly one embarrassing story each.

characters.name: Chef Bảo
characters.ability: Perfectionist: +20% dish quality while disposition is 60+; below 40 he may walk out.
characters.flavourText: Resigned twice over coriander placement. Was right both times.

characters.name: Tỵ
characters.ability: Apprentice: broth ingredients spoil one day later.
characters.flavourText: Stirs the pot like it owes him money. Tastes like it paid up.

characters.name: Colette
characters.ability: Consultant: critic events score +1 grade while she is on the roster.
characters.flavourText: Came for two weeks of consulting. Stayed for the broth.

characters.name: Auntie Chín
characters.ability: Quiet Money: at disposition 70+, unlocks expansion capital — on her conditions.
characters.flavourText: Owns half the street. Queues for noodles like everyone else.

characters.name: Dan
characters.ability: Fast Money: investment offers arrive sooner but demand more equity.
characters.flavourText: Says 'synergy' in three languages. Tips in exactly none.

characters.name: Vũ
characters.ability: Word of Mouth: +1 reputation on any day he eats at your cart.
characters.flavourText: Knows every shortcut in the city and the gossip on each one.

characters.name: Ngà
characters.ability: Truce: at disposition 50+, rival undercutting events stop targeting you.
characters.flavourText: Sold noodles against you for years. Respects how you lost.

characters.name: Sang
characters.ability: Wholesale: at disposition 60+, market prices drop 10% for you.
characters.flavourText: His grade A is everyone else's dream. His grade C is still fine.

characters.name: Long
characters.ability: Looking Elsewhere: at disposition 60+, pavement fines and confiscations halve.
characters.flavourText: By the book — but the book has a lunch break.

characters.name: Hạnh
characters.ability: Standards: inspection results swing double — shine or be shut.
characters.flavourText: Runs a finger along the counter. The finger is never wrong.

characters.name: Quang
characters.ability: The Column: pass his review for double reputation gain that week; fail for -10.
characters.flavourText: Reviews broth by ear. Claims he can hear the marrow.

characters.name: Mai
characters.ability: Viral: a 90%+ satisfaction day she witnesses doubles its reputation gain.
characters.flavourText: Her camera eats first, and her followers eat wherever she points.

characters.name: The Ghost
characters.ability: The Star: surviving both of their visits awards the Michelin star.
characters.flavourText: Nobody has ever seen them. The reservation is always for one.

characters.name: Grandma Yến
characters.ability: Secret Broth: once earned, permanently +10% dish quality. Cannot be lost.
characters.flavourText: Her recipe has survived three wars and one very nosy neighbour.

characters.name: Thu
characters.ability: After School: garnish prep is free on weekends.
characters.flavourText: Does her maths homework between orders. Carries the one, and the tray.

characters.name: Uncle Tám
characters.ability: Patch Job: cart breakdown events cost half as much.
characters.flavourText: Fixed the cart with chopsticks once. It steers better now.
